mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have pleasant conditions with partly cloudy skies at Harriet Park and a temperature of 75 degrees. The First Quarter moon is out, and tonight we are expecting a low of 58 degrees with no rain in the forecast. If you are up early, look for the International Space Station at 4:09 AM tomorrow as it travels from the south southwest over Belleville toward Fitchburg and Madison.

In city news, the reconstruction of Mark Drive is currently in Phase 2, which involves underground utility work and future sidewalk installations, while rehabilitation projects for Gateway Pass and other areas are slated for 2026.

Today you can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or join the fun at Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory; looking ahead, tomorrow features Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and trivia at Hop Haus.

Regarding the weekly police report, on Friday, August 15, a 44-year-old driver was arrested for an O W I after an officer observed her vehicle swerving and ultimately stopped to find her unresponsive behind the wheel.
Today is the perfect day to head to Culver's for the Double Strawberry flavor of the day; they are open until 10 PM, so you still have plenty of time to stop by.
